description: This file defines the RelativeStream class, a wrapper implementing StreamInterface to represent a subpart of an existing stream starting from a specified offset, mainly to conserve memory by avoiding copying the full stream.

classes.name: RelativeStream
classes.description: A final class implementing StreamInterface that wraps another stream to represent a subpart starting from a specific offset, providing methods for stream manipulation and memory-efficient substream handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RelativeStream with a decorated stream and an optional offset.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the contents of the stream, seeking to the beginning if seekable.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the substream, accounting for the offset.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position within the substream, adjusted for the offset.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at end-of-file.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the underlying stream is seekable.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position within the stream, adjusting for the offset if seeking from the beginning.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream, throwing an exception if the pointer is invalid.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream, throwing an exception if the pointer is invalid.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Gets the remaining contents of the stream, throwing an exception if the pointer is invalid.
